description: API gateway sudden CPU spike with thread count explosion

mocked_llm_hypotheses.description: Runaway request handler loop causing CPU saturation and thread accumulation

evidence.observation: CPU jumped from 45% to 98% — near saturation

mocked_llm_hypotheses.reasoning: The simultaneous CPU spike and thread explosion indicates a request handling loop that is not yielding — threads are blocking on CPU-bound work.

mocked_llm_hypotheses.description: Network routing issue causing request queuing

evidence.observation: High thread count could indicate threads waiting on network I/O

mocked_llm_hypotheses.reasoning: Network issues at the gateway could cause request pileup and thread accumulation.
